subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the five public memory-role slots, per-agent overrides, and hook-role metadata as the permanent memory plugin contract?
rationale: The branch adds broad persisted config and external plugin API surface whose role names, fallback semantics, and long-term support require maintainer product and ownership intent beyond mechanical code review.

options.title: Adopt the full role contract
options.body: Approve the proposed five roles and per-agent model once the layering repair, compatibility proof, and final-head behavior evidence are complete.

options.title: Land a narrower foundation
options.body: Keep only roles with current end-to-end invocation contracts and defer speculative public slots.

options.title: Pause for RFC redesign
options.body: Do not merge new public surfaces until maintainers choose a different memory composition contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the full role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed five roles and per-agent model once the layering repair, compatibility proof, and final-head behavior evidence are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history places him across the central slot, plugin runtime, SDK, memory, and UI surfaces, making him the best available owner for the cross-cutting product contract.
